'''Forgemaster's Armor''' was a type of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Forgemasters-Armor-Model.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Forgemaster's Armor asset by Anna Inkyung Lee and Brian Poche.]]
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[December 9]], [[2020]].<ref name="Reveal" /> The set was conceptualized by [[Anna Inkyung Lee]] and modeled by [[Brian Poche]], with effects by [[Bradley W. Lewis]], under the direction of [[Carrie Meade]].
<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=balron|url=artwork/3d8qRJ|name=[[Brian Poche]]|text=SWTOR Forge Master|date=2020-12-10|quote=SWTOR armor set for the Cartel Market. Concept by Anna Lee. Effects by Brad Lewis. Special Thanks to Carrie Meade for direction}}</ref>
